name: GPT-5.5
short: OpenAI's flagship (1.05M/128K, $5/$30) for coding and computer use; TB 2.0 82.7%, SWE-Verified 82.6%, GPQA 93.6%.
standout: The all-round OpenAI flagship of its era — coding, computer use and research in one dependable package that set the baseline for everything after.
tradeoff: Every successor (Terra, 5.6/6.1 Sol, Astra) undercuts it on price-per-capability, so it survives mainly as a compatibility default.
